先做第一件——搜真实抱怨。用 Reddit 搜索 RSS。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 400000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const fs=require('fs');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "function clean(s){return s.replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');}",
 "// Reddit 搜索 RSS：找提到 hours per week / manually / automate 的抱怨",
 "const queries=[",
 " 'hours per week manual',",
 " 'hours every week automate',",
 " 'manually every week spreadsheet'",
 "];",
 "const out=[];",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const q of queries){",
 " const u='https://www.reddit.com/search.rss?q='+encodeURIComponent(q)+'&sort=relevance&t=year';",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(u);",
 " out.push('\\n########## SEARCH: '+q+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' ##########');",
 " if(r.status===200){",
 " const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
 " out.push('ENTRIES: '+es.length);",
 " for(const e of es.slice(0,12)){",
 " const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
 " const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
 " const title=t?clean(t[1]):'?';",
 " const body=ct?clean(ct[1]):'';",
 " out.push('--- '+title);",
 " out.push(body.substring(0,450));",
 " }",
 " }",
 " }catch(e){ out.push(q+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
 " await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,100000)});",
 " }",
 " out.push('\\n=== DONE ===');",
 " fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
 " console.log('DONE');",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Search Reddit for manual-work complaints", run_in_background: true });
console.log(JSON.stringify(r));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const fs=require('fs');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "function get(u){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/rss+xml'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8')})});",
  "  }).on('error',reject);",
  "});}",
  "function clean(s){return s.replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,'\"').replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ').replace(/\\s+/g,' ');}",
  "// Reddit 搜索 RSS：找提到 hours per week / manually / automate 的抱怨",
  "const queries=[",
  "  'hours per week manual',",
  "  'hours every week automate',",
  "  'manually every week spreadsheet'",
  "];",
  "const out=[];",
  "(async function(){",
  "  for(const q of queries){",
  "    const u='https://www.reddit.com/search.rss?q='+encodeURIComponent(q)+'&sort=relevance&t=year';",
  "    try{",
  "      const r=await get(u);",
  "      out.push('\\n########## SEARCH: '+q+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' ##########');",
  "      if(r.status===200){",
  "        const es=r.body.split('<entry>').slice(1);",
  "        out.push('ENTRIES: '+es.length);",
  "        for(const e of es.slice(0,12)){",
  "          const t=/<title>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/.exec(e);",
  "          const ct=/<content type=\"html\">([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/content>/.exec(e);",
  "          const title=t?clean(t[1]):'?';",
  "          const body=ct?clean(ct[1]):'';",
  "          out.push('--- '+title);",
  "          out.push(body.substring(0,450));",
  "        }",
  "      }",
  "    }catch(e){ out.push(q+' ERR '+e.message); }",
  "    fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
  "    await new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,100000)});",
  "  }",
  "  out.push('\\n=== DONE ===');",
  "  fs.writeFileSync('C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.txt', out.join('\\n'));",
  "  console.log('DONE');",
  "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-pains.cjs";
